mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_invoice_type_statistics (stat_id, stat_day, invoice_type, issue_count, total_amount, total_tax, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{statId}, #{statDay}, #{invoiceType}, #{issueCount}, #{totalAmount}, #{totalTax}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_invoice_type_statistics WHERE stat_day = #{statDay} AND invoice_type = #{invoiceType}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_invoice_type_statistics SET issue_count = issue_count + 1, total_amount = total_amount + #{amount}, total_tax = total_tax + #{tax}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE stat_day = #{statDay} AND invoice_type = #{invoiceType}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(issue_count), 0) FROM t_invoice_type_statistics WHERE invoice_type = #{invoiceType} AND stat_day >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY), '%Y%m%d') AND stat_day <= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d')
